unit_system: SI base units unless the key name carries a unit suffix (_v, _a, _ohm, _ohm_per_km, _m, _mm2, _f, _h, _s, _us, _c, _wp, _kva, _j, _w). No other units permitted in derived files.

internal_structure.label: ASSUMED_typical_660Wp_half_cut_layout_pending_datasheet
internal_structure.bypass_diode_chain: D1,D2,D3 in series from J- to J+, each in anti-parallel across one substring; tap nodes N1 (S1/S2 junction) and N2 (S2/S3 junction)

single_diode_fit.method: five-parameter single-diode model fitted to STC Voc, Isc, Vmpp, Impp; fit values MUST be produced by claude-study/models/pv_module.py and recorded with residuals; do not hand-type them here

route_length_semantics.value: one_way_length_of_the_home_run_pair; loop conductor length = 2 x route
route_length_semantics.label: ASSUMED_consistent_with_phase0_one_way_delay

two_wire_line_defaults.label: DERIVED_by_claude-study/models/cable_line.py; values here are orchestrator sanity figures only

V_BOOST.description: Per-MPPT boost stage with series diode; input capacitor C_in per MPPT; shared DC link behind the boost diode cannot discharge into the PV side
V_BOOST.label: ASSUMED_DEFAULT_typical_large_string_inverter

V_DIRECTBUS.description: Strings connected directly to a common DC bus capacitor without boost diode; DC link CAN discharge into a PV-side fault
V_DIRECTBUS.label: ADVERSARIAL_VARIANT

string_fuses.reason: two strings per MPPT: typical omission; reverse current limited to one string Isc
string_fuses.label: ASSUMED

inverter_afci.action: inverter ceases to draw current from the affected MPPT input (string goes to open circuit at inverter side)
inverter_afci.label: ASSUMED_generic_not_a_product_specification

arc_model.label: UNCALIBRATED_ASSUMPTION; must be replaced by published-measurement calibration (Track E) before any extinction claim
arc_model.static_vi_law: Stokes-Oppenlander form V_arc = (20 + 0.534 * gap_mm) * I^0.12 (I in A, V in V) for I above a minimum sustaining current; arc extinguishes when I < I_min
arc_model.alternative: constant-resistance arc R_arc in {1, 2, 5} ohm as a cross-check only
arc_model.hf_signature: NOT modelled physically; detection studies use a separately documented synthetic HF band-noise injection labelled SYNTHETIC

P1.name: module_level_series_switch_outside_bypass_loop
P1.placement: SW-M-OUT: anti-series bidirectional MOSFET pair in the module positive lead, outside the bypass-diode chain
P1.action: open: interrupts the whole string loop at that module
P1.sensing: local DC current, local HF band, local terminal voltage

P1b.name: module_level_per_substring_switch_inside_bypass_loop
P1b.placement: SW-SS: one low-voltage switch in series with each substring, inside its own bypass-diode loop; opening a substring switch forces string current through that bypass diode
P1b.action: open faulted substring(s): module behaves as shaded; string current continues through D1..D3

P2.name: string_level_solid_state_breaker_inverter_end
P2.placement: SW-STR-INV: 1500 V class SiC breaker at the inverter end of the string home-run
P2.action: open: separates string from MPPT node, paired string and input capacitor
P2.sensing: string current, HF band, string voltage at inverter

P2b.name: string_level_disconnect_array_end
P2b.placement: SW-STR-ARR: switch at the array end of the home-run (last module junction box or string-end box)
P2b.action: open: separates the 30 modules from the home-run cable
P2b.sensing: string current, HF band at array end

P3.name: hierarchical_hybrid
P3.placement: SW-STR-INV + SW-STR-ARR coordinated, or SW-STR-INV + all SW-M-OUT with string-wide signal
P3.action: open both ends of the home-run

C1.name: module_internal_series_arc
C1.fault_location: series arc in substring SS2 of module M15 of string S20 (cell interconnect), INSIDE the bypass-diode loop of SS2
C1.fault_phase: arc ignites at t = 0 while string operates at MPP under STC irradiance

C2.name: external_field_cable_parallel_arc

fault_location_variants.C2-far: positive-to-negative parallel arc 5 m from the array end of the S20 home-run (931 m from inverter)
fault_location_variants.C2-near: positive-to-negative parallel arc 5 m from the inverter end of the S20 home-run

C2.fault_phase: insulation breakdown to arc at t = 0 while both strings operate at MPP
C2.note: irradiance 0 = night backfeed case: only capacitors and paired string (also dark) are sources

C3.name: high_resistance_hot_connector_no_arc
C3.fault_location: module-to-module mated connector between M12 (+) and M13 (-) of string S20, OUTSIDE any module bypass loop
C3.fault_phase: resistance ramps linearly from 0.00035 ohm to the variant value over 600 s; no arc ignition

figures_of_merit.E_fault_j: integral over time of v_fault * i_fault from fault inception until extinction or horizon; report contribution per source
figures_of_merit.residual_voltage: post-trip voltage at module terminals, section, string array end, string inverter end, MPPT node

explicit_prohibitions: no probability or failure-rate inference from Vogel/geometric sample fractions
no full-string Voc assigned to a module switch by assumption: solve the node
no arc-extinction claim from the uncalibrated arc law without stating it as illustrative
no claim that existing certified AFCI/SPD/fuses/IMD can be replaced
no reproduction of copyrighted standards text or vendor SPICE models
no agents or model families reported that were not actually invoked
